_about: What the Secretary of State's State Primary results files say of the State Representative and State Senate races, each party's primary its own race, read by src/parse/parse_sos_primary_results.py from the files in _source and held to the same year's general election (collected/election_<year>.json). Nothing in it is this project's decision but the nominees, which the files do not mark: the candidates with the most votes, as many as the race has seats and none with no votes; null where the count does not settle it.
Write the file again by running the reader, never by hand: --check says where the saved files and this disagree.
